title: Rhyolite (WIP)
description: Makes the names of minecraft stones more "geologically accurate"
body:
# Rhyolite: Geologically Correct Stone Names brought to you by Hive40 since 2025

Makes the names of Minecraft's Stones more "geologically accurate".

Idea from various YouTube Videos including: 

[https://youtu.be/uMx63AJShLE](https://youtu.be/uMx63AJShLE)

[https://youtu.be/0gVQK4wXevQ](https://youtu.be/0gVQK4wXevQ)

# What changes were made?

Stone becomes Rhyolite

Blackstone becomes Gabbro

Dripstone becomes Limestone

and more others I cannot remember because its 9 in the afternoon. 

If you think I made any errors, please contact me on our [support page](https://discord.gg/WQctxQdSDe)
